explainer_content.short_definition: 1970s punk at its first blast: fast, spare, anti-polished, and scene-built.
explainer_content.history_capsule: This road starts with New York minimalism and UK volatility, then branches into melodic, political, and artier versions of the same refusal.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It changed who could plausibly start a band and made small scenes feel historically powerful.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: Short songs, clipped riffs, shouted or sneered vocals, and DIY immediacy matter more than virtuoso rock display.
